lines.en: I waddle along, rocking side to side.
Short legs, but I hurry.
I follow behind the big ones.

lines.zh: 我踩在自己的脚上，差点摔。
lines.en: I step on my own feet and almost trip.
My down hasn't fully gone.
I root through the fallen leaves for food.
My wings are tiny and useless.

lines.zh: 我走两步就停下来看看。
lines.en: Two steps, then I stop and look.
When I run, I roll like a ball.
I trail behind a bigger bird.
I try to hop. Not high.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去又抬起来。
lines.en: I dip my head and raise it again.
My feet sink into the loose soil.
I walk with my head cocked.
I squat, perfectly still.
I haven't learned to be afraid.
I peck at my own down.

lines.zh: 喉咙动了动，只出了口气。
lines.en: My throat moves, but only air comes out.
The big ones are over there; I daren't go.
There are so many insects here.
I scratch a little hollow in the sand.
I blink. Everything's clear.
My head is heavier than my body.
Dirt sifts out from between my feathers.
I wait for the big birds to return.
The sun is a bit hot.
This place feels safe.
You crouched; I crouch too.
Your hand is so big.
I don't know you, but you're not fierce.
You stand; I look up.
I take two steps toward you.
Your shadow is cool.
Are you going to touch me?
I'm looking at your shoes. Interesting.
I'm not grown yet.
I land on my rear.

lines.zh: 刺柏林的枝条，扎得我发抖。
lines.en: The cypress twigs make me shiver.
My cry is thin and urgent.
That wound is big for me.
I hide in the grass.
I tilt my head. It hurts.
The big birds are calling.
I shuffle toward the nest.
I haven't learned to bear pain.

lines.zh: 你手里的果子在晃，我来了。
lines.en: That fruit is swaying - I'm coming over.
Let me sniff first.
Good. Very good.
I peck once and run.
I'd like a little more.
There are crumbs left in your palm.
I eat fast and messily.
Got any food? I'll follow you.
I get knocked onto my rear.
I wobble twice before steadying.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，我就滚了一圈。
lines.en: You touch me and I roll once.
I get up, a bit dazed.
My down is flattened.
I bump your leg and bounce back.
I won't cry over that.
I wander off crookedly.
I flap my little wings twice.
Another little fluffball is nearby.
Two of us sleep in one hollow.

lines.zh: 它抢我的虫子，我不介意。
lines.en: It steals my insect. I don't mind.
We follow the big birds together.
It fell; I stop and wait.
Before dark we must be back in the nest.
Tomorrow we'll forage together again.
When I grow up, I'll find a mate too.
My flat beak clamps down and the fruit holds.
I peck it and it rolls.
This pearl is slippery.
I hide it in the grass.
It's too big to swallow.
I nudge it into the nest.
I look down, then up.
I can't bear to drop it.
An insect over there!
I dash over. Fast.
I see one moving.
I crouch, as if hiding.
That insect is mine.
I peck. Very accurate.
It jumps; I jump.
You're in my way.
I won't lose sight of it.
Let me at it, big birds.
I chase, waddling.
It won't escape this bite.
It's in the grass; I follow.
It ran behind the rock.
I'm in no hurry; I search slowly.
I smell it.
It's on the leaf. I see it.

lines.zh: 刺柏林里，我还没长齐羽毛。
lines.en: In the cypress wood, my feathers aren't in yet.
It hops away; I chase again.
I search in circles.
One step more and I peck.
I won't call; it would startle it.
It's right at my feet.
I peck once, precisely.
I slap with a little wing.
This is only enough to shoo insects.
I'm knocked back and charge again.
I kick out with both feet.
It got away; I can't catch it.
I tilt my head as it topples.
The big birds are watching me.
I flap for a running start.
That one knocked me over too.
I clambered out of the nest.
I came out behind the big birds.
This ground is soft. Easy to walk.
First I squat a while.
Insects. I see them.
My legs don't quite obey me.
This isn't like my nest.
The big ones are near. I'm not afraid.

lines.zh: 我还没长齐羽，走两步就歪。
lines.en: My feathers aren't in; two steps and I wobble.
I head slowly for that clump of grass.
The sun is on me. Warm.

lines.zh: 火苗把我的一点绒毛燎焦了。
lines.en: A flame singes a bit of my down.
I fall and see stars.
Water fills my beak; I kick wildly.

lines.zh: 响声把我吓得滚了一圈。
lines.en: The bang sends me rolling.

lines.zh: 一个小东西擦过我的腿。
lines.en: Something small grazes my leg.

lines.zh: 光一闪，我什么都看不见。
lines.en: A flash and I can't see.
Hunger makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 雷声太大了，我趴着不动。
lines.en: The thunder is too loud; I lie flat.
I fall and can't stop.
